t: Meet Irina Astralova in the port of Novograd.

Very few heroes make it to the fifth level of Patronage, or even get close to it.

The ship of Irina Astralina has just moored in the port. She is one of the Free Traders, but she's been to every corner of Sarnaut in his days. They say, she knows the secret of the fifth level of Patronage, but she won't just share it with any stranger. And she definitely won't do it for free. She's a trader, after all!

Talk to her. I'm sure she will share his knowledge with you!

- Well-wisher

Fifth level, huh? I guess I can tell you something.

Take these Holy Symbols, you will need them. And since anybody and everybody and Novograd speaks so well of you, I will also give you a small personal present - a gift coupon for a Patronage Box.

Let me tell you how it works.
Give 10,000 Holy Symbols to Irina Astralova to get a Sacred Rune.

Do you want to get the fifth level of Patronage?
Free Traders can help you. Now I will tell you what to do.
First of all, and this is important - you must already have the fourth level of Patronage.
Secondly, you must be at least level 30.
Thirdly, visit the Boutique. A new item is sold there called Patronage Box. There are several Holy Symbols in every chest. Bring me 10,000 of them and I will give you the Sacred Rune. It will grant you access to an island where exciting adventure is waiting for you. Complete all trials there, and you will obtain the fifth level of Patronage.
Believe me, the fifth level of Patronage is worth every effort spent!

Excellent!
The Sacred Rune is yours.

Collect 10000 Holy Symbols and speak to Irina Astralova to get a Sacred Rune.
You may find the Holy Symbols under the Valuables tab.

Do you want to receive level 5 Patronage to us, the free traders, now anybody can do this. I will tell you what you need to do.
First of all, you need to have level 4 Patronage. That is important.
Secondly, you should reach level 30.
Thirdly, you need to visit the Boutique. There is A new product there - the Patronage Box. Each of them contains several Holy Symbols. These are what I need. Bring me 10,000 of these symbols, and I will give you a Distorted Rune. This is unique, and will be your ticket to an island, where you will have an unbelievable adventure. once you have undergone all the Trial with honor, you will receive level 5 Patronage don't forget, once you have collected 100 symbols and united them, you can activate level 5 Patronage for a short time and experience all the advantages that it provides!
Believe me, the fifth level of Patronage is worth every effort spent!

Excellent!
The Sacred Rune is yours.
Bring the Sacred Rune to Irina Astralova to travel to the Forgotten Temple and get the fifth level of Patronage.

Do you have the Sacred Rune?
Few adventurers can boast the fifth level of Patronage. You must be extremely lucky to find the Forgotten Temple Isle where Agrus the Great Dragon lives. If you come to an agreement with him, he will reward you with the next level of Patronage.
But first you have to get to the island. Bring me the Sacred Rune and I will send you to the adventures in the Forgotten Temple!
You are very close to obtaining the new level of Patronage. Bring me the Sacred Rune to make the first step!

Great!
Using the power of the Rune I will send you to visit the Great Dragon.
Tell me when you are ready to go.
Use the coupon to purchase a Patronage Box at the Boutique, open it and combine 100 Holy Symbols. Report to Irina Astralova in Novograd port.

Holy Symbols are like small particles of faith. While they are few and scattered, their light is weak. But as they pile up, they start shining as brightly as hope on the darkest day! Remember this - it will help you in the future.

Collect 10,000 Holy Symbols, and the fifth level of Patronage will be forever yours. But there is a way to try it out just for two hours. It will only take 100 Holy Symbols. You already have 90. With this coupon I gave you, you can obtain a Patronage Box from the Boutique, which will additionally grant you certain amount of symbols.

Try it! You will see for yourself all the possibilities of the fifth Patronage level.

Can you feel it? Can you feel the power filling you up? I can see that you do. Be proud of yourself - the fifth Patronage level is not something anyone can experience.

Now that you have this power, try it in action. Remember, you only have two hours. If you want to possess it permanently, collect 10,000 Holy Symbols and come back again. We will set out on an unforgettable journey.
Meet Marianna de Ardeur to obtain the first level of Patronage.

Attention, League Citizens!
Patronage abilities can now be obtained in Novograd! Pay a visit to Marianna de Ardeur in the Church of Light. Get stronger and wiser! Get the power of one of the Twelve Great Martyrs!
I repeat...

Why are you here?
Do you need consolation? Do you want to honor the memory of Tenses?
Or maybe you want to get to know your Martyr?

Why are you here?
Do you need consolation? Do you want to honor the memory of Tenses?
Or maybe you want to get to know your Martyr?
Take part in May celebration in Novograd.
This Certificate of Honor is presented to you for your commitment towards supporting the League and defending the Motherland. The invitation to the celebrations is attached.
The celebrations will start soon. Try not to be late!
How do you like fireworks? Beautiful, aren't they? Pure Kanian engineering, no magic at all! They're working on something even more fascinating now. Come again, it'll be fun.
Use the brazier and other ingredients to cook meat.

Now that all our enemies are taught a good lesson, it's high time to regain energies and have a good meal. Whatever the fruitarians might say, I'm sure meat is the best food for a warrior! No man can survive without meat, and not a single lady may stand the smell of freshly roasted lamb rib. Is your mouth watering already? Good!

Open your gifts to find spice and sauce for your barbecue. You may also buy some ingredients from Silantiy Vinegarov right here. If your mastery in cooking equals your mastery in combat, your dish will be delicious! And if it won't, don't be upset. I'm sure it'll still be edible.

As soon as the dish is ready, eat it while it's hot. Or invite a friend to your table! After you've finished, come back to me.
The smell of barbecue is so delicious, I'm afraid it will lure hungry beasts from the Astral!
How was it? Was it awesome? I knew it! Here's your gift.
Equip the banner, gather 15 Proofs of Exploit and listen to Aidenus' speech, then return to Zabava Mayskaya in Novograd.

History of the League is the history of heroic deeds. Today we celebrate exploits, performed by our greatest heroes, dead or alive, and in combat, we prove that we're worthy of their greatness. I am proud to give you this Banner. Next time you enter a battlefield, make sure to raise it to the glory of the League! You should also bring back to me proofs of your exploits, performed under the Banner. As soon as you bring enough, you will receive a reward!
Yet another thing you should know. Aidenus will give a traditional celebratory speech. My advise is that you come and listen to the leader! To motivate you further, every guest of the ceremony will receive an honorary gift. Special guests will receive special gifts!
The enemy trembles upon a sound of your name! This is so good.

Well done. Keep it going and bring me all you can gather. I will exchange the proof to a decent reward. If you really liked Aidenus' speech, you may listen to it again and again, and receive more presents.
Ask Zabava Mayskaya about the celebrations.

Greetings, hero! Don't you just love these days of spring, with the smell of flowers, birds singing and light breeze... And the traditional barbecue, of course! I bet it's your favorite! If you want to have some, talk to Zabava Mayskaya! She's in charge of the May barbecuing. You will have to prove your valor in combat first, though!

I won't delay you any longer. Hurry to Zabava. I bet you'll be able to surprise her!
I've sent a note to Zabava, she's waiting for you.
I've been expecting you, hero. Your bravery and deeds have brought you glory and fame. We can celebrate this at our May event!
Bring the fish to Maya Korchakova.

You've already done a great jon here. I often see you running errands... Lovely sight!
That's why I decided to ask you of another favor.
Have you met Maya Korchakova, innkeeper? Anyway, she and I are... partners! She sends me different sweets and I send her fresh fish. I have a sweet tooth, you know.
Could you perhaps bring Maya a barrel of fresh fish? I owe her some...
It's so hard for a widow to live alone... So hard!

What's that? Fish from Anchut?
Right in time! It means that tomorrow I will have fish broth in menu. People will crowd here!
Meet the Unselfish Family in Novograd bank to learn about the new program.

Good day! Have you heard of a new recruitment order aimed to bring new heroes to Sarnaut? Free Traders will give you fantastic rewards for inviting a friend into our world!
Learn more about it from the Unselfish Family of the Free Traders.
Have you heard of the new campaign sponsored by the Tycoon Club to support defenders of Sarnaut?
Now you know everything. Find yourself some followers, grow them into real soldiers and get your reward!
Talk to a representative of the Tycoon Club in Novograd bank to learn about the new program.

Good day! Have you heard of a new recruitment order aimed to bring new heroes to Sarnaut? Free Traders will give you fantastic rewards for inviting a friend into our world!
Learn more about it from the Unselfish Family of the Free Traders.
Have you heard of the new campaign sponsored by the Tycoon Club to support defenders of Sarnaut?
Now you know everything. Find yourself some followers, grow them into real soldiers and get your reward!
Ask Stepan Pimenov about the Kingdom of Nature.

You're no longer a newbie in our craft. It's time we let you in on a secret. Ever hear about the Kingdom of Nature? No? That's right: that's a special nook for us wardens only. Don't you tell anyone about it! Or it'll be swarmed with all sorts of curious types who'll defile it... There's no life for us without this place!
Go to Stepan Pimenov and tell him I sent you. Listen to him carefully... And keep your mouth shut about all that you hear!

We shouldn't be teaching this to novices so early... In my time, only the tried and tested were told about the Kingdom of Nature. It required three years of apprenticeship and a dozen initiations. I guess times have changed. Listen up.
That's all. Now you have the sacred right to visit the Kingdom of Nature. Behave yourself there: Mother Nature is not to be messed around with, and neither is the Green Peace!
Visit four Holiday Committee Officials in Novograd and take their advice for a gallant chevalier.

Is there anything difficult in meeting someone and falling in love? Building a relationship can be a real challenge. Good thing that there always will be old folks to pass on some useful advice.
I may not be so handsome, but I know what ladies want. The only thing that unavoidably attracts ladies is your strength and power. Show her your strength, carry her in your arms and hold her tight. Then she'll follow you to the ends of the world!
I know it for sure, you must show her who is the boss! Anyway, you better ask our Holiday Committee Officials for some other tips.
Ladies are like flowers in a vase, they are so beautiful and vulnerable...
What would I advise? Meet a new lady with caution! Should you try to go straight ahead, she may give you a slap.
h: Ask for a piece of advice for a gallant chevalier.

t: Here's my advice: when you hop into his arms, give him a hug and a languish sigh... and he's all yours!
h: Ask for a piece of advice for a beautiful lady.

t: Visit four Holiday Committee Officials in Novograd and take their advice for a beautiful lady.

Is there anything difficult in meeting someone and falling in love? Building a relationship can be a real challenge. If you want to charm a young man, be delicate and tender, make him feel he's protecting you. You can put your head on his shoulder and sigh as if you're tired... Then he'll follow you to the ends of the world!
You probably know these guiles better than me. However, go ask our Holiday Committee Officials for some other tips!

The last but not the least, be you the fairest beauty in the world, you must be able to cook the yummiest dinner! As every lady knows that the shortest way to her lover's heart lies through his stomach!
Meet Goryana Izerskaya, the Construction Council agent, at the Field Hospital .

This situation with the hidden weapons requires our immediate attention. We can't allow the weapons to fall into the rebels' hands.
This operation will require some serious preparation. Thankfully I have someone to rely on.
You will meet another Construction Council agent. Goryana Izerskaya is a Kanian noblewoman, but unlike many of them she understands that the future of Kania is in unity of all classes. Together with her you will go on solving that mystery.
You can find Goryana at the hospital to the south from Novograd, at the border of the Southern Birchwoods. Look for cloth armor seller. That's her. Yes, Construction Council agents are not strangers to work under cover!

It seems you are not going to buy anything...
So you're from Pavel. What's the news?
Visit Pakhom Rogov, the Construction Council agent, on a shore of the Adder Plateau.

We are going to verify this new information and prepare a backlash, in the meanwhile you can do something else.
One of Lightwood strategic locations is the Farshore Shipyard on the western coast. The rebels tried to seize the shipyard but we managed to hold it.
However, there are still some problems there. For example, I don't have a smart agent there. But have a goofy one.
He seems to have brains and clever eyes, but does everything in a slipshod manner. I told him to find out the shipyard workers' state of mind but he overplayed his hand. They took him for an imperial spy! He almost died and now he's living in a tent on a shore.
Go visit him. Find out if he's ok.
What's wrong? How can I help?
Ah, you're from the Council... Got a new assignment for me?
Use the Ancient Megaphone to call for Cami the Daydreamer's brothers so that the Lostlings Family unites.

Ahhh! I'm lost! Ahhh!
Help! My two brothers are running around Novograd looking for me! And I'm looking for them too. I'm already tired of running!
Here, look - I have an Ancient Megaphone. Use it to shout out very loud, so everybody hears. Okay? I have almost lost my voice. I wish I find my brothers!
Come on, shout louder! This is not the Megaphone from the Boutique, but it will do fine anyway!

Here they are! Hurrah! At last we are united!
Now you know how useful this Megaphone is, if you want to say something important to everyone.
Go to the White Lake to the north of the Lightwood and speak with the Sauna Attendant, Osip Petalov.

Wait!
In your eyes I see a glitter of resolve to change the world for the better! I see in you the one who can defy the Plague, that infected the Church of Light!
Yes-Yes - the Plague! We, the priests of the Church of Light must be pure in everything, we must set an example to follow! But is it like that in real life? No!
At the White Lake, which is located to the north of Novograd, is a black, dirty blot. The house of sin and perversion! It is scary to imagine, but my brothers and sisters frequent it, giving innocent excuses, in which only a blind man will not see a lie! I am talking about a bathhouse!
If you are prepared to serve the cause of Light, then go there. I am absolving you of sin, in advance, which you will commit to reach a higher purpose. You will need to earn the trust of Prokhor Lepestkov, who works as a bath attendant in that damned place and obtain evidences of sins committed by my lost brothers and sisters. It is not too late to guide them back to the True Light!

Hello, hello!
Are you here to bathe or for some other need? If it's the first one, then welcome!
On the south coast of the White Island, break off 4 birch branches and bring them to the Sauna Attendant, Procurus Lepestkov.

Why am I asking? A funny thing happened not long ago.
A priest from the capital dropped by yelling about how much light costs, waving his hands, and cursing everything. He promised to burn down my bathhouse! It's been here since the beginning of time, it helped so many people cure their illnesses. Oh!
So... time for a bath? Time for a schvitz? It's great. The only thing is that I'm running out of birch switches. And what's a good steam without a switch?
Let's do this - you bring me some birch branches from the woods, and I'll let you use the bathhouse for free. The best spot to collect branches is on the south shore of the lake. The trees there are thick and full...
Deal?
What's a steam bath without any switches? It's laughable!

These are good branches, well-formed. They'll make an excellent switch!
Thank you.
With the key to the bathhouse, enter inside and steam with the help of the bathhouse twig-bunch of 3 League veterans.

So, off to the steam bath?
I'll be glad to let you in but you see...
While you were away, a whole militia group has arrived. From the Holy Land, meaning from the very front line. All wounded and tired... Steam bath is the best treatment for them. It'll heal them like no magic-shmagic would. Sure thing! Fair heat breaks no bones!
Listen, why don't you help me? I can't do it all by myself... I'll give you the key and a flag broom. You go right in and use the broom on our veterans. But spare no pains! They'll like it!

A, a nice hot bath! What could be better?
As we say in Kania - "Taking a good steam bath is like being reborn!"

So, enjoyed the steam bath?
Let me be honest with you, I'm the happiest man alive! I do what I love to do, I bring joy and health to people!
Return to Denis Kokarev and hand him the invitation from the bathhouse.

Now you really know what proper Kanian baths are all about!
So, you got something to say to this crazy priest?
Relax! Siver has had it in me for a long time! You're not the first spy he's sent here! He's restless, always suspecting everyone of sedition! He doesn't understand that baths are purely for washing! Nothing more, nothing less!
Go see him and tell him that I'm inviting him to the baths once again. Let him come and see it for himself. Maybe he can wash all that stupid thinking out of his head! If you ask me, there should be a law forcing everyone to wash in the baths once a week. This will make a great tradition!
Well, what can you tell me of that filthy place?

Oh... I look at you with pity... The twinkle in your eyes is no longer, your body is limp... You don't care anymore!
No! It does not fit me to send others to that damned place, dooming them to eternal sorrow! I will go myself! I will get to the bottom of it myself! I will find the truth myself!
But first, a bath...
Complete all objectives set by Helena Bugakova, the Joiner of Hearts, in order to divorce.

Oh... Are you really that unhappy? Are you really sure that you are making the right decision? Think it over! Try again from the start! Find the remains of your past love in your hearts!
No, you can't?
Then you can divorce. You must buy divorce papers from me and read them here in front of me to your spouse aloud.
If he or she agrees you should sign them here. And you... alas, will be divorced.
I hope you think it over a hundred times before you make this step.
Are you sure you want to divorce?

There is nothing left to do...
In the name of the League and with the permission of the Light, I pronounce you free from the matrimonial ties which bound you before.
I hope you find your future spouse as soon as possible and return for a new legal marriage.
Complete all objectives set by Helena Bugakova, the Joiner of Hearts, to register a legal marriage.

I'm so glad to see you. To join the hearts of lovers is the best job in the world. Now I will tell you what should be done to become a happy newlywed.
First of all, you must buy Wedding Rings and Wedding Dress from the Boutique. Secondly, your future spouse must put on the Wedding Dress and appear before me. As you initiated the wedding, you must have 10 gold coins to pay the marriage tax. To register your marriage both of you must be over level 18. You cannot register a marriage with a character of the same gender.
If you meet these requirements you may propose to your future spouse. You will need Wedding Rings; one of them will be presented to your fiance!
As soon as he or she receives the ring it should be put on to confirm their consent to get married.
Is everything clear?

My dear!
In the name of the League and with the blessing of the Light, I announce you husband and wife!
Let your marriage be long and happy. Let your path be easy. Let you find happiness, love and harmony together.
Peace be with you!
Meet Pierre de Desirae in the Elven District of Novograd.
I've received a letter from Pierre de Desirae. He asked me to tell you that he would be glad to see you again. If you find yourself in Novograd, visit the Elven District.

Avery de Grandeur told us about your service. Raoul de Doucer surrendered. Thank you for your assistance.
However, it isn't the end of the House de Doucer story.
I have a new task for you. But... I'm not sure you can cope with it.
It's quite unexpected to receive this from your hands. Thank you for the great honor.
h: Pass the Invitation to the Great Ball

t:
Hmm. Not so bad.

After that one time, I've been supervising the local harbor, looking for smuggled and counterfeit goods. This is a crowded node, it keeps me pretty busy.

Siveria is slowly being populated, mainly by Gibberlings, but Kanian saltworkers, hunters, and woodcutters, also come here.

The nobility has been visiting us over the last year. They're plotting something. Mark my words.

I'll be happy to visit a big city and the Great Ball. I hear, they are going to grant amnesty to House de Doucer. I can't wait to see.
h: How are you doing in Siveria?

t: Go to Men-Khatton Necropolis and release the Spark to locate a Rancid Zomby. Kill 3 Rancid Zombies and report to Georgi Vityazev.

It seems that we're not the only ones interested in purging Siveria of the undead. The Molotov Family recently approached me with an unusual request.
Many scouts and mercenaries working for the merchants have been killed in this area. It got to the point that even the most desperate soldiers of fortune refused to work with the family.
The executioners are to blame. They are a special type of undead that is incredibly dangerous and very hard to find. They attack suddenly and violently from under the snow and after they've killed their victim, they go back into the snow to hide, waiting for a new mark.
The Molotovs have figured out how to find these executioners. They've sent me a vessel containing the soul of a fallen mercenary. If you take this vessel out to the battlefield and release the soul, it will lead you to its killer, and then it's your job to execute the executioner!
The men were killed just to the south of here. The Molotov Family has marked off the area.
It seems that the merchants are willing to do anything to clean up the filth of Siveria.
I'll inform Molotovs that you have killed some, but the family won't rest until they're all dead. Come back tomorrow after we have received a new vessel.
Use Magic resonator on Glacial Elementals to get them clean, collect 30 drops of pure water and bring them to the Judge Avery de Grandeur.

I can tell that you already mastered the Piercing Gaze ability. Do you want to improve it? I can help.
You must learn how to remove everything unnecessary and concentrate on the main point.
Here, take this magical resonator. You can use it to clear the Glacier Elementals living on the Cape of Good Hope from impurities. Use it on elementals weakened in battle.
If all goes well, you will run into the purified elemental instead of normal one. Fighting it is the most important part of your lesson. Defeat purified elementals, collect 30 drops of pure water and bring them to me to prove your training is complete.
Only putting aside all unnecessary, only concentrating on the main, it's possible to grasp new knowledge.

Here it is - the moment of truth!
Your eyes can see now what is hidden from others. This is a valuable skill, will be very useful.
Find the 3 hovering stones in Taiga Glen, the Northern Riverside, and along the Vertush Shore. Report back to Anthropologist Mitrofan Gomonov.

There are many mysteries hidden under the snow. It's up to us to dust the snow off and take a good long look at everything.
There's a legend about strange, floating stones around these parts. They're said to be engraved with some sort of writing. Are they grave markers? Beacons?
To learn these answers we'll have to go out and find them ourselves to examine! I've heard reports that these stones are in Taiga Glen, the Northern Riverside, and along the Vertush Shore. Once you find them, hurry back and tell me everything!
What are you doing here? The stones are out there waiting for you!

Perfect!
You're on your way to becoming a true anthropologist!
Collect 4 Siverian Trophies from the most dangerous creatures and return to Anthropologist Mitrofan Gomonov in Molotovka.

The local wildlife can be fearsome! But how will we ever learn anything new if we're afraid to venture forth?
We'll never get anywhere if you're afraid of the likes of Fuga the Keen, Snowcharger, Sleetpaw, Icefang, Rimehorns, or Old Sharptooth!
So I want you to get out there and prove your courage! Slay these dangerous creatures and bring me back a trophy as evidence!
How did you fair? Are you fearless yet?

Excellent!
Those beasts have been defeated and these trophies you've gathered prove it!
Kill 50 waterfolks in Siveria and report to Mitrofan Gomonov in Molotovka.

Unfortunately, this land is far from perfect. There are still those out there that pose a great danger to our civilians!
Take those waterfolk, for example. Insidious, slimy creatures, that are creating all sorts of lawlessness on the Vertush River. Disgusting.
I'm positive that fate will bring you to them. Take that opportunity to show them who the real law is around here!
Does the mean uttering of your name strike fear into the hearts of those disgusting little creatures yet?

Thank goodness for that.
It will be much more peaceful on the Vertush now.
Bring 5 Barrels of Pickled Omul to Anthropologist Mitrofan Gomonov in Siveria.

Have you ever eaten pickled omul? No, of course you haven't. Only the waterfolk know how to cook it. It's the most well kept secret of Siveria!
I've had it once, it was... WONDERFUL! Everyone here craves it. I'm sure that even just a few barrels would be worth a fortune!
No one here is brave enough to explore waterfolk territory, but you sure are! Just keep an eye out while on your travels. I know you'll find some somewhere. But be careful because I think they're on to us. They've started putting out empty barrels too.
Those sneaky waterfolk hide barrels of pickled omul around all Siveria.

Oh! My mouth is already watering!
We'll be sure to send a few barrels to the Holy Land as a present for our Defenders!
Complete all of Anthropologist Mitrofan Gomonov's tasks and then return to him in Molotovka.

I've got a special gift for you if you can complete all of my assignments.
Well, three, actually. But you can only choose one! It's something that is bound to be helpful for all of you travels!
 So, be sure to find those pickle barrels, floating stones, and defeat those terrifying creatures! Prove your love for Siveria!

How wonderful! So few were eager to help me with my research!
Go ahead and choose your reward!
Talk to Vlad Strezhnev in the Molotovka Trading Post in Siveria.

Because of you, all of Lightwood has become more peaceful lately. If only we had more people like you this world would be a much better place. Oh well, there's no point in daydreaming! We still have a lot to do and we can't waste time on trifles.
I have just received a dispatch from Siveria from Vlad Strezhnev, commander of the League Defenders at the Molotovka merchants' trading post. He's asking for help. I'm placing you at his disposal - I'm sure he will find a good use for your abilities.
Siveria is a wild and harsh country to the north of Lightwood. We've only just begun to conquer it - we are literally biting into the ice and snow and making alliances with local tribes. We have sent out a major expedition under Ermolai Sotnikov... although we haven't heard from them in a long time. There's plenty of work, I'm sure you'll find something to do.
All petitions must be answered by the deadline! So don't bother me.

Ahh, so you're the one Aidenus wrote to me about!
We have lots of work that needs to be done... Lots of new arrivals in Molotovka and they all need to have their papers done, and, would you believe it, they are the ones calling us lazy-bones and grafters. It is a thankless job, but someone has to do it. And on top of that, the aboriginals have revolted a few days ago!
How are we supposed to handle all this?
I'm glad you're here.
Deliver Maya Korchakova's letter to her brother in Molotovka.

I kept wondering how I could repay you for your help. And here's what I've come up with - my brother, Timur, runs a tavern in Siveria. Hah, it's almost like we have a tavern keeper dynasty in our family. Anyway, I've written him a letter where I recommended you very highly.
You'll find Timur in Molotovka, a trading post in Siveria. Give him this letter and he will find you a suitable job. To get there, head north along the eastern shore of White Lake. The road will lead you to Siveria. Good luck!
Yes, wine is very expensive around here now thanks to irregular deliveries! But what can I do about that?

Aha, look at that! Maya sent me a letter for the first time in over a year. Something important must have come up! Let's see now...
Ah, so her husband has passed on. Well, may he rest in peace. Actually, I never liked the guy. She's not saying what the cause of his death was, but she keeps lavishing praise on you.
I'm not used to taking anyone's word, least of all my flighty sister! I'm sorry, but first we need to test you in action, then we'll see what sort of person you are!
Use the portal in Molotovka to travel to Novograd and meet with Maya Korchakova.

I have a proposition for you.
You see, my family just got a lot bigger! My wife, Ludmila, gave birth to three boys recently! What a gift! They're all sturdy and good-looking too! We've named them Andrey, Vladimir, and Oleg. I'm sure they'll do some damage when they grow up.
I want to share the news with Maya. I thought of sending a letter but now that you're here...
Can you go back to Novograd and tell Maya the good news? The faster the better, so it would be a good idea for you to use the portal. It'll take you to Novograd and back in seconds! And you will learn how to use portals, too.
This task should be a breeze!

What?! I have three nephews now? Boy, is that good news, or what?!
I would give you a hug or a kiss, but I can't. My Kudeyar is so passionately jealous. If he were to find out, I don't know what he'd do.
Speak with the Eyepopping Family in Gravestein.

Our intelligence agency has been plagued by misfortune. More of our Astral agents have disappeared - the Eyepopping family.
A cousin of my grandma's neighbor's sister recently saw them in Siveria. She says the Eyepopping family is back from an assignment and has been visiting with their relatives in Siveria for a while, but then they just vanished without a trace. They might have been kidnapped by the enemy or taken by a beast...
Like all the other Gibberling reconnaissance agents, the Eyepopping family was involved in the search for our lost homeland. That's why we desperately need to know what they found didn't find on their last mission.
You've been such a great help in the past, would you be willing to help out again? I need you to find out who they spoke to, and what they talked about. It'd be best to start in Gravestein, a small Gibberling settlement in the very heart of Siveria. That's where they were last seen.
What did you want? Huh?! Speak up! We fell off a ladder when we were five and we've been hard of hearing ever since.
So, the Gray Family sent you? Why should we believe that? We're old, but we're not senile just yet. What if you're a spy? We need to set up some sort of test for you!
Speak with Avery de Grandeur on Cape of Good Hope.

The head of the disgraced House de Doucer is hiding out in Siveria. There are many secluded locations where he could be hiding, and we've already dispatched an avenger to look for him. However, we'd like you to help him find this criminal.
Our avenger's name is Avery de Grandeur and he is now exploring Siveria with Ermolai Sotnikov. Find him and offer to help with whatever he needs.
This mission may also be related to our "Nameless One". There are plenty of dark spots in the history of the House de Doucer. Perhaps later we'll have the time to tell you about all the subtleties of the Great Game...
I've been asking for help for a long time. I just assumed that my letters to Pierre de Desirae were lost en route.

I had to part ways with Ermolai some time ago. He went into the Cursed Temple and no one has seen him since. Now I'm stuck here with the others, holding back the undead that are pushing hard for the coast. I already know the location of the fugitive and with your help I hope to catch him.
Accompany the raft to Gravestein and defend it from the waterfolk's attacks.

Let's get back to business! My brother Yefim is now in Gravestein. It's a Gibberling town just beyond the mountain range. I must send some important cargo to him, but we have a little hitch...
The waterfolk along Vertush River are not only into poaching, but piracy as well. Their camp is to the east at the river bend - it's where they launch all their raids from.
I need a reliable guard who will be able to accompany the raft and beat back the attacks from those water vermin - I'm sure you're up to the job. The rafters are already waiting for you by the pier - talk to them and get on your way.
Where's my cargo? Has Demian forgotten about our business? Is he just goofing off now that I'm not there to keep him in line?

Finally! I thought those damned waterfolk had intercepted the cargo again. They're a real pain, you know. I'm glad my brother got you involved in this business! I'm sure there'll be plenty of work for you here, too.
Speak to the Thoughtful Family in Gravestein.

Ermolai Sotnikov! A born leader - decisive, bold... We'll never find another man like him. He wanted to explore the new land in Siveria, so he got some people together and headed east.
We haven't heard any news from the expedition for a long time, and now you've found this helm... The thing is, Ermolai isn't in the habit of leaving his armor lying around! That's why I have a job for you - I want you to follow his trail and find out what happened to him.
A good place to start would be to go see the Gibberlings in Gravestein. Ermolai had to have passed through there. Talk to the elders, maybe they've heard something!
Our town is new and we are a peaceful people, but we're always able to stand up to our enemies!

So, you're looking for Ermolai? Since Vlad has entrusted you with such a serious matter, we'll tell you everything we know. Ermolai and his people did indeed stop here. He said that he was going to travel up the river to the very edge of the allod, but we don't know if he made it or not. However, we do have a lead you can follow!
Set the owls free and travel to Frozen Frontier to speak with Froddy the Fidget.

Hear me out and deliver this message to the Gibberling Enclave. I have finally found our homeland. Or rather, what's left of our homeland. Now it's just a bare rock in floating out in the Astral... The Gibberlings don't have a home anymore!
Go to the archipelago... Frozen Frontier... Find Froddy, the Gibberling Elder... To get there... Go to the Cape of Good Hope, they will direct you...
You must tell the others about it or my death will be for nothing. Set the owls free, let them fly to my mothers. They will understand what has happened to me. They will understand...

I'd hate to say it, but... I had a hunch. The Astral is swallowing up the world, I just wanted so much to believe that our homeland survived this chaos and is awaiting us still!
My dearest Gibberlings, what's to become of us now?! I implore you, speak not a word of this to anyone!
I don't blame you for it. Here is your reward. May it keep you warm in this cold place. I just don't know whether the Gibberlings will ever be warm again...
Find the rebels' messenger in the ogre caves and ask about Andrey Molotov for Igor Molotov at the Sieged Stronghold.

Unfortunately, I don't know anything about where Andrey is, but we did have the mutineer's messenger in the stronghold. His name is Vlad Uzelkov but who knows if he's still alive...
He was taken prisoner by the ogres along with Yefim Molotov and the Eyepopping family... Those poor bastards - they're probably all dead by now.
If you'd like to try to find him, your best bet would be to go to the ogre caves in the Bone Valley. It's not far from here, just across the river. But you probably won't find anything but his bones by now.
So what happened to the messenger? Eaten alive?

So Vlad was lucky! Strange, how that happens - so many worthy people have perished here, and this small fry gets off without a scratch!
But on the other hand, it's thanks to him that we now know where the rebels have hidden away Andrey.
Board the rebel ship, kill Captain Kryukov, take the key, and free Andrey Molotov.

Grave Bay is to the north, across the river. In order to get there, you'll have to pass through a cemetery, which means that you are almost certain to meet undead so be careful! There's a narrow gorge called Tombstone Crevasse that will lead you to the harbor. Get yourself on that ship, take the key and free Andrey! It won't be easy - those mutineers are real desperados and Andrey too much of a big shot for them to let him go easily. And this Captain Kryukov has a reputation for being a real cutthroat.
Get ready for a major brawl!
Watch out for those damned rebels, this place is thick with them!

So it was Yefim that sent you, my dearest brother! I knew that the Molotovs would not dance to someone else's tune forever. Finally I'm free!
All that's left is to get off this damned boat.
Bring 4 skulls from the cemetery near Tombstone Crevasse to Arthur de Delice at the Sieged Stronghold.

In spite of everything that has happened, I intend to continue my research. There is no end to work for a historian in these mountains and I am especially interested in the ancient burial grounds of the Zem people. I've already studied the barrows and tombs near Gravestein, so now it's time to turn to the cemetery near Tombstone Crevasse.
I'm sure that you've run into Siverian undead by now. So you've noticed that they're exceptionally dumb and quite unlike the Arisen of the Empire.
This is quite peculiar and I need to know the reason. Bring me four skulls from Tombstone Crevasse. Perhaps they will help me to find the answer.
When studying history, you'll find more questions than answers. Like "where are the skulls that I asked for?"
Thank you, I will start studying them immediately. Your help was invaluable and I wish to reward you.
Rescue Andrey Molotov and return to Igor Molotov.

Let's not waste time chatting. There's an Astral boat here, that's where we'll split up and I'll escape into the Astral where I'll have a better chance to lose them. Don't worry - I know how to control the boat. The important thing is to reach it alive - these mutinous scum aren't likely to let us pass without a fight!
So, did you manage to rescue Andrey?
Great, that's just great! Andrey is alive and free! This good news merits a good reward!
Take the documents you found to Georgi Vityazev at the Cape of Good Hope.

Found amongst the Valir captain's things were several interesting documents that contain information about the sources financing of the Kanian mutiny. Something about the "gold of the damned" and some sponsor known only as WK.
It wouldn't hurt to show the discovery to a League Defender. Georgi Vityazev in the Cape of Good Hope would be the ideal candidate for this.
Rebel documents? How interesting... Let me see.

Oho! These documents are priceless! Now that I understand who is financing the rebellion, we can shut it down.
There, the rebels can expect nothing more from the Molotovs. And you deserve all the credit, by the way. But there's also this mysterious WK... But we'll let the intelligence people figure out who is hiding behind those initials.
Search the crypts along Tombstone Crevasse for 2 more Zem Tablets and take them with Andrea de Desirae's report to Arthur de Delice at the Sieged Stronghold.

It's time to show Alfred just how deeply mistaken he is! I have prepared a report where I have laid out the proof of my theory. Take it to Alfred de Delice. That old fuddy-duddy has gone north to the stronghold - I'm sure that he is still there, digging among the rotten skulls as usual.
But I'm sure that old jerk will find something to pick on, like "the tablets are worn, your conclusions are hasty!" So, let's do this right. There's another burial ground to the north of the Sieged Stronghold, along the Tombstone Crevasse.
There's got to be more tablets, just like the ones here! Find them and give them to Alfred. Then he won't be able to weasel out of it, he'll have to admit that I'm right!
He'll finally have give me credit in the History of Necromancy course!
Hm... There's a strange glitter in your eyes. Do you have something to tell me?

Oh, great Astral! Youth and arrogance can lead to such great idiocy!
And Andrea de Desirae showed so much promise. The daughter of such a glorious House, a passionate, seeking individual! And she submits such a silly amateurish report!
Of course the ruins belong to the Zem undead! I have never contested this. The problem is that they are not inhabited by the ancients raised from a long sleep, but by simple zombies and skeletons. This is the contradiction I am trying to resolve, to understand why there isn't a single representative of the Arisen in these lands! And the silly girl is wasting her time and mine on empty talk, proving something that's crystal clear, even to a moronic Orc...
I do not wish to talk about this matter anymore!
Kill 4 Bear Tribe Fighters or Bear Tribe Shamans. Report to Mila Ogonkova at the Sieged Stronghold.

The Arrow Family told me about the white orcs. So they're the ones that set our forest on fire! Unfortunately I'm needed here, but we need to take revenge.
You must go to the tribe's camp and slaughter four fighters or shamans!
You'll find the camp to the northeast, on the other side of the mountain range. You'll know it when you see it. It's hard to miss.
I can't go with you, but I will reward you handsomely for your help.
I cannot sleep while the blood of our friends cries out for vengeance. An eye for an eye!

The Orcs are dead? Well, honestly, death in battle is too light a punishment for what they've done here. Let their bones rot unburied! Here's your reward. Bear this weapon with honor, it served the defenders of the Stronghold.
Find 4 bundles of furs hidden by the Orcs in the Tombstone Crevasse and bring them to Igor Molotov.

I'm looking at these charred remains and I just can't believe my eyes. It hasn't even been a month since I made a trade deal with the Bear Tribe! I'm so naive... Why would someone do business with them!
Those bastards promised me bundles of furs. I saw them myself. So I gave them a down payment... In weapons. The same ones they used against us!
That's so awful. We can't get the weapons back, and the furs... Hey, wait a minute, let's do this: you'll go back to the Orcs' land, find the bundles of furs, and bring them to me. At least four of them. It will serve them right! They should have known better than to break trade agreements!
Man, I hope I get those furs. I even have a buyer lined up already...

Thank the Astral, now I have something to impress the family! It was them that financed the deal after all. I already thought it was all over, that they would have fired me for embezzlement.
Thank you!
Pick up Ermolai's trail in the Bear Tribes' camp to the northeast.

Now that our more urgent problems have been solved, we can go back to talking about Ermolai.
His fate is a matter of concern for all Gibberlings - Ermolai did much for our people. Unfortunately, I personally cannot help you, but I'm positive that the Bear Tribe knows something. That's why they dared to attack our stronghold. They were afraid to mess with us before, they must have figured something out.
If I were you, I'd drop into their camp and see for myself what's going on! You just might find something interesting.
I thought you were trying to find Ermolai? Don't just sit there, get your butt to that camp!
Yes, this is Ermolai's shield. I remember him leaving our stronghold with it. Interesting... I wonder where those beasts could have found it?
Take the Mysterious Amulet of the undead demonologist, Arthur de Delice, at the Sieged Stronghold.
A strange amulet that came from a very strange owner... It would be wise to take this amulet to the demonologist Alfred de Delice in the Sieged Stronghold. Let him figure it out.
You say an undead was commanding the Orcs? And this is his amulet? Amazing!

Have you seen the intelligent undead that are part of the Empire? They appeared right after the Great Cataclysm when Tep's pyramids were destroyed and the trapped souls returned the dead bodies of the Zem people.
All of the crypts, burial mounds, and ruins were left behind by the Zem. My theory was that the souls could not reach the bodies in these parts and the dead remained in their graves for many hundreds of years...
Now I see that they have become a consumable resource for an evil force who will use these undead up and then throw them away. I thought there was a powerful necromancer at work here! I was already drawing up a detailed report for the Defenders... And here you are with this amulet and a story about an intelligent undead!
Damnation! My theory is bursting at the seams!
Speak with Georgi Vityazev at the Cape of Good Hope.

This trail leads to the Men-Khatton Necropolis, such an eerie place!
Ermolai was also going to visit Men-Khatton, so if you're going to keep searching for him, that's where you should be heading next. It's not hard to find the Necropolis, you just follow the river going northeast and as soon you start seeing ancient burial mounds then you know you're almost there!
But first you should stop by the northern coast, the Cape of Good Hope. Find Georgi Vityazev, one of the League Defenders - he's a pain in the butt but there's not much else we can offer.
Tell him everything we've managed to learn about Ermolai, this information is very important to the League. Maybe he'll be able to tell you something in return!
You're not from the capital? Is the portal working normally now?

Sigrid... yes, I remember, though I still don't know why people call her Leather Stocking! The last time we saw Ermolai around here was when he was heading for the Cursed Temple with his men. It is an ancient Zem temple behind the Men-Khatton Necropolis, at the eastern edge of the allod.
I said that nothing good would come of it but Ermolai, like all heroes, didn't listen to good advice. And so he went to the temple, and perished there together with all his people.
You say that the Orcs and the waterfolk have fitted themselves in his armor? Well, that's a bad sign!
Tell Gorislava Lyubimtseva at the Cape of Good Hope about the intelligent undead in Siveria.

Near the edge of the allod there is another large burial ground, the Men-Khatton Necropolis, an ancient cemetery of the Zem, and within the necropolis is a huge, cursed temple.
I was wrong about there being no intelligent undead in Siveria... The Zem undead, this is serious! But the question is, who are they serving?
A port was built recently on the northern coast and according to rumors, Gorislava Lyubimtseva, a priestess of the Church of Light and Prioress of Siveria, arrived there recently. Tell her everything we have managed to learn. I am sure this matter goes beyond the scope of a theoretical dispute about necromancy. Perhaps together we can figure out what is going on here.
Greetings. Are you seeking a blessing or do you have some news?

Intelligent undead in Siveria? Hm... This would explain much...
I don't see any reasons to mistrust this Elf and that's where Ermolai disappeared, at that Cursed Temple.
It looks like all the threads in this story lead there and we will have to pay it a visit too, unless we want to keep repelling the attacks of the dead forever.
Gather 4 Crates of Supplies for the Thrifty Family on the Cape of Good Hope.

Ah, our poor ship, our poor Sludge Splitter... It'll take forever for the repairs to be finished! That damned storm! We knew it - we could tell that something was going to go wrong.
We guess we should be thankful that everyone is alive and that only the ship was damaged. Unfortunately, all the cargo was scattered along the shore!
Please help us gather it before someone finds it and takes it for themselves. But be careful, there are many ice elementals along this coast. Nasty things, they are.
When an Astral storm tosses a ship around like that, there's only one thing going through the mind of the captains - the hope that the insurance will cover it!
What a barbaric place! There's a portal to the capital, but no tavern! Where are thirsty captains supposed to take a load off? We can't even buy you a proper pint of ale for a job well done!
Collect 4 portions of Magical Ice and bring them to Gorislava Lyubimtseva on the Cape of Good Hope.

Fighting off the spawn of darkness is my sacred duty. This is precisely why I was appointed prioress of this inhospitable country. Unfortunately, courage and a sharp blade aren't enough to overcome the undead - it also takes magic.
You must have run into the ice elementals already. We've figured out a way to imbue their magical ice with holy energy. A weapon treated with this ice does much greater damage. Why don't you go get four portions for me. It will be a good contribution to the common cause.
At least those elementals are good for something! So, where's the ice?
Thanks, this is just what we need. It'll be much easier for us to overcome the undead now.
Kill 4 Malicious Zombies, Skeletal Ravagers, Skeletal Explorers, or Vicious Zombies. Report back to Georgi Vityazev on the Cape of Good Hope.

Forgive me, I have no time for lengthy conversations, the undead are relentless with their attacks. They crawl out of the Necropolis like cockroaches - we barely manage to beat them back!
It looks like they're intending to drive us off the Astral coast at any cost. We need your help. Go to Men-Khatton, where the undead are all pouring out from.
Take a good look around and kill seven of each type of undead. Hopefully this will give us a respite from their attacks.
No, I won't send anyone with you, I have too few men as it is. Who's going to guard the port and our ship?

I'm glad you managed to dispatch the undead so quickly. We could really use a breather. This is a real fight for survival, you know! It's them or us!
I have a suspicion that there is someone behind these undead, someone very powerful. Perhaps even... No, I don't want people to think I've lost my mind, so I had better keep quiet.
Oh, if only Ermolai were with us!
Sprinkle Frankincense Oil inside 3 tombs. Report to Gorislava Lyubimtseva on the Cape of Good Hope.

I'd like to send you on a mission that is truly holy. The Men-Khatton Necropolis is a cursed place and we, the servants of Tensess, must use all the means at our disposal to defeat the undead.
There are ancient tombs scattered across the necropolis that the undead are all climbing out of. We can put a stop to this. Take this frankincense oil that has been blessed at Tensess Temple and sprinkle it on those tombs. This is how we'll end the invasion of the undead!
I will pray to Tensess to give you the strength to carry out such a righteous act!
The tombs have all been sanctified? Then accept my words of gratitude and the blessing of the great Tensess!
Find the head of the disgraced House de Doucer in the Necropolis.

The head of the disgraced House de Doucer is hiding out somewhere in the Men-Khatton Necropolis, among the ancient graves and the living dead. What a truly sad ending for a once great family, forced to find shelter amongst ancient graves...
Unfortunately, I cannot go there myself at the moment. We have too few experienced fighters and the undead never stop their attacks on the coast.
Therefore, you must go to the Necropolis in my place and find the fugitive. Be careful, this is one of the most sinister places I've ever seen and the fugitive may offer serious resistance.

Lower you weapon! I'm not going to fight you.
This may sound strange, but I'm glad that it's finally over.
I am tired of hiding and this evil cemetery is definitely not a fitting place for an Elf, even one rejected by his own people.
Take the Emblem of the House de Doucer to Avery de Grandeur.

You want to know what my crime was? Let's just say that I didn't exactly play by the rules. The Great Game has become sacred to the Elven houses. It affects everything, from our politics to family intrigues. My family, the House de Doucer, broke the rules and so I have become an outlaw.
I'm tired of hiding. I'm handing you this emblem of the House de Doucer. Take it to Avery de Grandeur as a sign of my voluntary surrender. He will understand... I am voluntarily putting myself in the hands of the ruling House de Desirae to let them decide my fate. I myself will journey to Tenebra soon and put myself at the victor's mercy...
The undead are advancing again? Oh, it's you... did you find our fugitive?

Even having become an outcast, an Elf never forgets about his honor, which is yet more proof that our race... Nevermind, I'm not going to talk about that subject.
Well, my mission is done - the Emblem of the House de Doucer guarantees that Avery will keep his word. I won't fail to inform Pierre de Desirae about your part in this affair. Please accept this weapon as your reward - you've earned it.
Go to the Cursed Temple and find out what really happened to Ermolai.

I believe, and the Prioress agrees with me on this, that we should send another expedition to the temple of the undead beyond the Necropolis right away.
This is the only way we are going to find the answers to all our questions and, most importantly, find out what happened to Ermolai and his men!
Go there and remember that it's the most dangerous place in Siveria.
May fortune, and, of course, the blessing of Tensess, be with you!
What are you waiting for? There was plenty of time to get ready!

Well, now we know the whole story. Ermolai and his men ran into an ambush in the temple and never had a chance. Oh, if only he had listened to me!
Who is going to stand in the way of Tep and his undead now? Will you have the courage to take up Ermolai's cause?
Well, in fact we have no choice - all that's left is to hope for the best, prepare for the worst, and arm ourselves. And, by the way, here's your reward for your exploits in the Pyramid - this is excellent steel, you won't find anything better in the entire allod!

I didn't think there would be anyone courageous enough to come here after my death. My soul has been captured by Tep's and become a prisoner of this temple forever. But then again, I suppose it's better to be a fleshless ghost than a living corpse.
We were ambushed as soon as we entered the temple. My people fought bravely but we were outnumbered.
This new evil is merciless and the undead multiply by the day. Their master is a Great Mage to the Zem people. If he is not stopped, this entire allod will turn into one massive graveyard and that would be just the start of this blight. I cannot stop Tep but I believe in you, your strength, intelligence, and courage. Finish what I started and save our world!
Goodbye! Remember me!
Uncover the identity of the Ancient Lord in the Cursed Temple and return to Gorislava Lyubimtseva.

As the prioress of Siveria, I am troubled by this "Ancient Lord" more than anything else. I've heard this name before, and you should be familiar with it by now as well. It looks like we're dealing with the Arisen. Do you happen to know anything about the cult of Tep?
Tep was a Zem Great Mage and the creator of the Arisen. In his quest for eternal life he killed all of his people and imprisoned their souls in massive pyramids - the Cursed Temple is one of these pyramids.
After the Great Cataclysm, most of the pyramids broke open, releasing the souls and raising the Zem people from their graves. Now they've joined forces with the Empire.
The cause of the mutinies, the undead, and Ermolai's disappearance is all the same. It has to be Tep. I'm sure that thousands of souls are held captive deep inside his pyramid by his cultist servants, while the Ancient Lord is in fact Tep himself. Go into the Cursed Temple and see if my suspicions are correct!
What else do you want to hear? It's time for action!

So, it's true. The Ancient Lord is none other than Tep himself. Well, he certainly chose a snappy alias. It doesn't look like his temper has become any milder over the centuries. Well, since we're dealing with a Great Mage of an ancient age, we should expect some serious trouble. I've prepared a reward for you - it'll come in handy, considering the situation.
Take the Undead Reconnaissance Report to Gorislava Lyubimtseva.

In the heap of bones you find strange document. It's the report of Arisen scout!
"...Our reconnaissance group was sent to Siveria in order to check on the ancient temple of our people located here.
The information we have obtained here is of exceptional importance.
It has been established that Tep, a Great Mage of the ancient age, is alive and planning to conquer all of Sarnaut. The temple in Siveria is one of his pyramids that survived the Great Cataclysm and the reserve of souls within remains untapped. This is why our compatriots were not resurrected in these mountains until recently. However, Tep has used the souls to selectively resurrect his cultists, who have helped to spread his dominance over the wild Orcish and waterfolk tribes in the surrounding area.
According to Tep's agents, service to their Lord requires the destruction of men, Elves, and Gibberlings.
The expedition of Ermolai Sotnikov, the Kanian hero and explorer of new frontiers, had interfered with Tep's plans and was destroyed. Obviously, at this time the League does not have reliable information about Tep's plans and is unable to intervene.
Unfortunately, our group did not manage to escape unnoticed and we have virtually no chance of returning. We have already suffered great losses, but will still attempt to fight our way through to the lowest level of the pyramid, where our Astral boats are docked. We do not fear death, but if this report does not get into the hands of the leader, Nefer Ur, we will have died for nothing..."
This is a report from one of the Imperial intelligence officers spying on the undead, a pile of bones seem to be all that's left of his unit. This document must be delivered to Gorislava Lyubimtseva posthaste.

The Imperial Intelligence Service and the Nefer Ur spies did a huge amount of work here in Siveria right under our noses. However, their luck ran out...
And now we will benefit from the fruits of their labor. This report corroborates the information we had already suspected. I shall definitely attach it to the report that I've already started drawing up for the Great Mage Aidenus.
Take Lyubimtseva's Report to the Aidenus in Novograd.

My report for Aidenus is ready. He needs to learn about everything that has been going on out here as soon as possible. You must deliver these papers and hand them to him personally, and do try not to dawdle, the news is too troubling.
Oh, a familiar face. How's the weather in the mountains? Any news?

This report is a real bombshell. If Tep is alive, then he is an adversary that is more fearsome than the empire and the rebels combined. How distressing!
So, Ermolai is no longer with us. I knew this hero personally, and his death is a severe blow to the entire League.
Oh, yes, Gorislava has attached a note to the report where she mentions your good service. According to her, it is you that we have to thank for discovering Tep and Ermolai's fate. I guess I was not wrong in sending you to Siveria.
Find the Gold of the Damned and take it to Georgi Vityazev.

So, what do we know? One of the sources of financing for the rebellion was the "gold of the damned" that the rebels obtained in the Cursed Temple. Now... Captain Kryukov has written that "all kinds of undead have crawled out and the remainder of the treasure is still in the temple".
Our job is to find that gold and use the funds to cripple the rebellion. Let the "gold of the damned" serve a good cause! Go to the temple and find that treasure!
We must get the gold and deliver it to those in need. So, what are you waiting for?
Here it is, the gold of the damned, the gold of the rebellion. May this contemptible metal serve a good cause! For the sake of the League!
Eliminate 4 Tep's Cultists in the Cursed Temple. Report back to Georgi Vityazev on the Cape of Good Hope.

The time has come to strike at the heart of the enemy! If the undead have a heart, that is...
It's time to go into the temple and start purging it of the undead that guard it. The answers to all our mysteries lay in that unholy place and that is where you will have a chance to show your courage, valor, and audacity - the qualities that are inherent in every citizen of the League!
Gorislava believes that the main assault should be targeted at Tep cultists, as she calls them, I personally see no difference since they all deserve one thing - death.
Onwards! For the future of the League!

Finally, we have time to take a breath. The day is not far off when the ruins of the Cursed Temple will be covered in snow, hidden away and the evil forgotten.
In the name of the Light!
Gather 4 measures of Astral Dust and bring them to Feodor Vetrov.

You seem to be ready.
Listen carefully. To begin the initiation rite, you must collect four astral dust measures and bring them to me. There are many will-o'-the-wisps on this shore, whose radiance attracts astral dust. Believe me, this is the best place to collect dust. Do not return empty-handed!
Then we will continue.
Have you gathered enough Astral Dust?
Wonderful! Now, to move on to the next phase...
Kill the Mystical Demon Mage and return to Feodor Vetrov.

For the last part of your initiation, you must kill an Astral demon.
You might think it hard to find one of the beasts these days. It's true that the League Defenders did a wonderful job of clearing them out, but there is one place in particular that the demons still flock to.
How fortuitous for you that it just so happens to be right on this shore. To the east, not far from here, there's a peak where the demons visit very frequently. Go there, kill it, and return to me so that we may bring this ritual to a close.
The time when we feared the demons has passed. The forces of the patrons are with us now!

The rite is complete.
Now you can use the Incense I gave you to appeal to your Patron. It will help you in combat.
Speak with the Mysterious Family in Novograd.

Welcome! Many come to us after acquiring a patron. Would you like to learn more about runes? We can tell you everything there is to know about them as well as the finer aspects of working with them. First of all, let's issue you a level one rune of your patron. Keep a tight hold on it! It'll come in handy.

Now that your patron has been selected, I want to tell you about one more thing. Runes are magical objects that contain the power of each patron.
Long time ago craftsmen didn't know anything about the Twelve Great Martyrs and simply used the magical powers of the runes to enhance their abilities.
Now you can learn to activate and combine runes. I recommend that you go to Novograd's Gibberling District and find the Mysterious Family who can tell you much more about this than I.
Talk to Feodor Vetrov and ask him to call the mighty bear and defeat him in battle.

Soon you will come across runes - magical stones imbued with the powers of the Martyrs. Long time ago people knew nothing about Twelve Great Martyrs, but now the runes are used on purpose. You should learn how to activate runes of your Patron and combine them to greatly increase your powers.
I want you to see for yourself how the runes make you stronger. I'm going to summon my pet for a training fight, you'll fight it without a help of the runes first.
My bear is a serious contender. You'll have to try to defeat him.
So, the bear is defeated. But look at yourself! You spent a lot of energy, you got injured, you need time to recover from the battle. Very familiar scene, is not it?
Talk to Feodor Vetrov and ask him to call a pet and give yourself the power of runes and defeat the mighty bear in battle.

Ready for another fight? Don't worry, it will be much easier. My spell will make you stronger and give you extra protection, as if you were using runes of the fifth level!
I want you to feel the powers of runes - they all can be yours!
Let me know when you are ready to start.
Only when you have tried the power of runes, you will understand how important it is!

So? Feel the difference?
That's a power of runes! Hope you remember this lesson.
Bring 2 pieces of Yak Meat and 2 pieces of Venison to Timur Korchakov.

So, here's your first task. If Maya wasn't lying about you, you should be able to handle it with no problems. The Molotov Family have placed a nice contract for salted meat. Everyone knows that the best meat for salting is yak and deer.
You can find them to the east of the outpost. Bring me two pieces of each type of meat and we'll have a done deal!
Please do not delay! The Molotov family are very serious customers and we don't want to lose their contract!
Ah, here's the meat, just as we agreed. I see that Maya was telling the truth after all. However, we need one more thing before we can give the Molotov family the salted meat.
Collect 4 Fir Cones for the Dashing Family.

Hello! Are you looking for a job?
We're the Dashing Family - newly arrived from Lightwood. We're good at turning a profit! So it's a chance for you to earn some coin. Just stick with us!
Now, let's get down to business. Majestic cedars grow in Lightwood with cones full of pine nuts! Those nuts are what we're after. They are delicious!
We're planning on opening a business here in Siveria. We'll harvest, process, and sell the nuts. It's a great idea but there's a bit of a problem - there are no cedars here! We suppose firs could do, but we'll need to taste their nuts first.
We'll give you a stick to knock the cones from the trees. Bring us four. We're the only nut experts around here! So we'll sample the goods!
Oh, I forgot to tell you about the sabertooth squirrels, there are lots of them over there. But we don't need any squirrels, just the fir cones, please.

You brought the cones! Let's get those pine nuts out! Hm, why are they so small? Well, size isn't everything. Let's have a little nibble... Ugh, they taste awful! Maybe this wasn't such a good idea after all. Thanks for your help.
Kill 4 Silver or Red Lynxes. Report back to Taras Khripunov in Molotovka.

Hey, want to make some money? The Molotovs need skilled hunters. The thing is: there are way too many lynxes on our shore. Their numbers need to be reduced to a reasonable minimum. Ideally, to zero. The task is not an easy one, but the Molotovs are not afraid of difficulties.
Kill four gray or red taiga lynxes - and you'll have money in your pocket. Look for the cats in the vicinity of Molotovka, there are a lot of them roaming around here...
Next! Who wants to make some money? Come on over!
No, I won't come with you. I'm allergic to cats!
The hunt was successful, I see. That means another step towards solving our problem has been made. We'll root out all the lynx at this rate. They have no business here on our land!
Elimnate 4 Waterfolk Poachers, 4 Waterfolk Witches, and Illyar the Brutish. Then report to Taras Khripunov in Molotovka.

I have a job for you on behalf of the Molotovka merchants. However, this is more serious than just hunting deer. It's only a job that can be done by experienced warriors.
You see, the waterfolk have been poaching our waters! They've been catching fish in the Vertush River without permission and using banned techniques! We've sent them warnings but they can't read and talking to them is useless.
So, I want you to head down to the river and rough them up. Maybe that will teach the others to respect the law!
Remember to get the witches too - they use their shamanic dances to put spells on the fish. And if you manage to meet up with their boss, then teach him a lesson too! You'll find the waterfolk at the delta to the north of here.
How are things with the waterfolk? No mercy for the poachers!
So the waterfolk received a good kick in the pants? Good, maybe now they will wise up. The Molotov Family asked me to give you a gift for your exploits. May it bring you good fortune!
Speak with Natalia Koreshkova in Molotovka.

This is some situation we have here! Savages are revolting, colonists are pushing in from all sides...
And now my men have fallen ill with some mysterious disease and our medic is powerless! You must be careful too - you don't want to catch this infection.
I need you to find Natalia Koreshkova in the village, she's a folk healer, a wise woman... In short, a witch! Maybe she can suggest something to help.
But don't tell our medic that we have someone who's not into traditional medicine.
If you've come for a love potion, it takes Snake Skin. And it's very hard to come by around here.

Oh, Vlad Strezhnev has need of my help? Tell him to first issue me a wise woman's license. I've been waiting far too long for it! And until I get it, then let a real physician treat them.
Wait, wait... I didn't really mean it! Of course I'll help. How can I not when someone is sick!
Bring the wise woman a Deer Heart, a Yak Horn, a Squirrel Ear, and a Lynx Tail.

There is an ancient remedy for the disease, it's called the "Siverian Decoction". It takes a deer's heart, a yak's horn, a squirrel's ear, and a lynx's tail. And try not to confuse them! There was a fellow here once who wore himself ragged looking for horns on a squirrel. And he found them! But of course, I had no use for them.
Oh, and please don't dawdle - all the components must be fresh!
You think the recipe is too strange? Hah! You have no idea just how strange recipes can be!
Did you bring everything? Great! I'm going to brew an elixir, but no peeking. This secret has been preserved in our family for ages and I want to hold on to the monopoly.
Take the Siverian Decoction to Vlad Strezhnev.

Here's your piping hot medicine! Take it to Vlad Strezhnev and if it does not help his defenders, then I'm not even worth one copper as a wise woman!
Maybe now the wait for my license will finally be over. Oh, and another thing - tell him to give my regards to his learned healer!

Any news of Ermolai? Oh, it's you again!
So what did the wise woman say? Will she help us?

Smells appetizing. Maybe I should take some as a preventive measure? No, let someone else try it first. Who knows what sort of side effects it might have!
I hope this elixir will help us to overcome the disease. In any event, you deserve a reward for your hard work.
Collect 4 Salt Crystals for Timur Korchakov in Molotovka.

We solved the meat problem, but that means the job is only half-done. Now we need salt. We usually get it from the Molotovs' salt factory, but there's one problem - the goblins on Salt Lake have rebelled and blocked the access road. We can't lose the contract because of some goblins!
Get yourself over to that lake and collect the salt crystals on the shore. Four of them will do fine. We'll make it the traditional way, just like our grandfathers did it.
Salt is a commodity. There have even been rebellions because of it, or rather because of its lack.

Wonderful! Now the Molotov family will surely come to me with all their new contracts! Of course, I will gladly admit that you deserve the credit. And to show my appreciation, I'll feed you to your heart's content!
Kill 4 Goblin Warriors or Goblin Hunters and the leader, Skipjack the Wet. Then report to Vlad Strezhnev in Molotovka.

There's still no news from Ermolai, but there are more and more problems popping up every day. I'm sure you know that the goblins have rebelled on Salt Lake and attacked the Molotov Family's salt mine.
I have no idea what they would want with a salt factory, but those merchants are all over me, demanding that the issue be resolved immediately. But I have no soldiers well enough for an expedition. The decoction from the wise woman is a wonderful thing, but our sick are only just now starting to recover.
That's why I want to give this job to you. Go to Salt Lake and win back the salt factory! But most importantly, kill their leader, Skipjack. He's one insidious bugger!
Maybe after this, those damn creatures will respect the agreement with Ermolai.
How are our goblins doing? I beg of you, save the Molotovs from them, and me from the Molotovs!

So the goblins are gone? It's amazing how such small creatures can cause such big trouble.
Let's hope they'll cooldown, I have enough worries without that damned factory!
Charge the amulet with rage from 3 tigers and bring it back to Natalia Koreshkova in Molotovka.

Our soldiers put their lives on the line for us, so I want to prepare presents for them in appreciation - tiger charms! But they need to be charged with a magical power.
Tiger rage is an excellent source of this power so I'm giving you a special amulet to collect it. Use it when the tiger is wounded and it'll go berserk. Its rage vibrations can then be captured by the amulet. You won't miss this moment if you're an attentive hunter. And then I'll find a way to extract it and put it into charms.
Collect the rage of three tigers. I know this is a dangerous game, but the result is worth it!
We need to charge the amulet as soon as possible. I can't wait to see the results!

The defenders should like the charms and, to be honest, I hope that Sterhnev will take note of my accomplishments. Maybe they'll even give me a medal, what do you think?
And for you, I have another useful item! Yes, this very same charm. Use it wisely! The pagan magic of the druids can be a dangerous weapon!
Collect 3 Useful Ore Samples and bring them to the Dashing Family.

It doesn't look like the nuts are gonna pan out... That's too bad! It was such a great idea!
Well, we have others! Since we're friends now, we want to share a secret with you! If you pick the right spot here in the mountains, you can literally get showered with gold. We can feel it in our guts - there's lots of gold here. Not like in Lightwood!
We can't leave this town yet since we're still waiting for our travelling papers. Why don't you go to the mountains and inspect the ore veins. The best spot is the Northern Riverside. Find at least three deposits. Here, take this tool to help you with the job. Make sure you don't lose it! We don't have enough money for a new one...
Tell us, were we right about the gold?

Aha! So our hunch was correct! Soon we'll be the richest Gibberlings on this allod. It's too bad that we're orphans - our mother would've been really proud of us.
You know, no one ever had any faith in us before. They always said we were just amateurs, but now things will be different, you'll see!
Speak with Denis Molotov in Molotovka.

It looks like you just got one lucky break. Denis Molotov himself has developed an interest in you and wants to meet you. Hurry up and get ready - he doesn't like to be kept waiting. The Molotovs control everything around here so try to get along with him - it's in your own best interest, after all!

Well, alright, let's get acquainted. I'm always eager to welcome more capable people, doing business in Siveria is far from simple!
There's so much to worry about and it is so hard to find a reliable assistant. Nothing but grafters, cowards, and slackers around here! But I see that you're nothing like that... I am sure we'll get along just fine.
